items.title: Joe Muranyi interviewed by Monk Rowe, New York City, New York, January 11, 2007
items.q: And I met Artie Shaw, I knew Artie Shaw a little you know.

ctx.x: Yeah they needed a tuba, right?

Yeah, like that. I said no. I never thought of it. No, no, no. She said well trumpet? And she said clarinet? And you know I must have been pretty hip already or something, but I immediately thought of Artie Shaw or Benny Goodman. “Yeah, the clarinet.” It’s very funny you know. And Woody Herman. I knew Woody Herman a little and I told him this story. And I said you’re one of the guys responsible. Matter of fact I told Benny Goodman too. You’re one of the guys responsible for me.
